info.title: IRThermal
info.summary: Thermal camera streaming, measurement and metrics.

get.description: Liveness: the process is up and serving.

Readiness: every camera is connected.

Deliberately separate from liveness. A camera being unplugged should not
make an orchestrator restart a process that is otherwise working fine.
Palettes accepted by the rendering endpoints.
Every configured camera and its capture health.

schema.title: Response List Cameras Api Cameras Get

get.description: One camera, including whatever its latest frame reported.
Live MJPEG. Drop it straight into an ``.

The uncompressed 16-bit pixels, for analysis rather than viewing.

Readable with `numpy.load`, and the same shape v1 wrote with its `r` key.
Configured points, plus the frame's own extremes.

post.description: Min, max and mean over a rectangle, clipped to the frame.
Trigger a shutter calibration -- the audible click.

schema.title: Response Set Range Api Cameras  Camera Id  Range Post

patch.description: Write measurement parameters. Omitted fields are left as they are.

post.description: Start a lock-in run. Returns immediately; poll the job for progress.

get.description: Every run this process still remembers, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

delete.description: Stop a run and release its load. Finished runs are left alone.

get.description:
Both demodulated components, for analysis rather than viewing.

Readable with `numpy.load`, which gives a mapping of `in_phase` and
`quadrature`. Magnitude and phase are derived from those two, so storing
them as well would only be a chance for the file to disagree with itself.
One component of a finished run, rendered.

CameraDetailOut.title: CameraDetailOut
CameraDetailOut.description: Status plus whatever the most recent frame told us.

LockInJobOut.title: LockInJobOut
LockInJobOut.description: A run's progress, and its shape once it has one.

LockInRequest.title: LockInRequest
LockInRequest.description:
A lock-in run to start.

The serial port is deliberately absent: it comes from the camera's
configuration, so the API cannot be used to open an arbitrary device on the
host. See `CameraConfig.lockin_port`.

MeasurementOut.title: MeasurementOut
MeasurementOut.description: A temperature reading at a pixel.

ParametersRequest.title: ParametersRequest
ParametersRequest.description: Measurement parameters to write to the camera. Omitted fields are left alone.

RangeRequest.title: RangeRequest
RangeRequest.description: Which temperature range the camera should use.

RegionRequest.title: RegionRequest
RegionRequest.description: A rectangle to summarise. `x2`/`y2` are exclusive.

TelemetryOut.title: TelemetryOut
TelemetryOut.description: What the camera reports about itself.

TemperaturesOut.title: TemperaturesOut
TemperaturesOut.description: Every configured point on one frame, plus frame-wide extremes.
